Adding the Path variables

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tools)
library(grid)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

prefix  <- "LGG_MUT" 

project <- "/Volumes/UVABX-PK/TCGA_GBM_LGG_Correlation_Analysis_Sep_2026"

matrix_files <- c(
  LGG_WT  = "LGG_mergedcounts_TCGA_LGG_WT-normcounts.txt",
  LGG_MUT = "LGG_mergedcounts_TCGA_LGG_MUT-normcounts.txt"
)

expr_file   <- file.path(project, matrix_files[[prefix]])
region_file <- file.path(project, "tucr_regions_from_GBM_WT.tsv")
cnv_dir     <- file.path(project, "lgg_cnv_files", "sample_cnv")
map_file    <- file.path(project, "lgg_cnv_files", paste0(prefix, "_sample_cnv_map.tsv"))
output_dir  <- file.path(project, paste0(prefix, "_tucr_cnv_overlap"))
plot_dir    <- file.path(project, paste0(prefix, "_tucr_cnv_plots"))

tucr_ids    <- c( "uc.110", "uc.164", "uc.234", "uc.284", "uc.17", "uc.113")

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(plot_dir,   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# helper: output file in the project folder with prefix
out_path <- function(name) file.path(project, paste0(prefix, "_", name))

# check inputs
for (f in c(expr_file, region_file, map_file, cnv_dir)) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Not found: ", f)
}

# which CNV method each sample uses (ASCAT3 / ASCAT2)
cnv_map <- read.delim(map_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Dataset     :", prefix, "\n")
Dataset     : LGG_MUT 
cat("Matrix      :", basename(expr_file), "\n")
Matrix      : LGG_mergedcounts_TCGA_LGG_MUT-normcounts.txt 
cat("CNV map rows:", nrow(cnv_map), "\n")
CNV map rows: 382

Data preparation: overlap each patient’s CNV with the TUCR regions

# ── Load expression matrix (once) ───────────────────────────────────────────
expr <- fread(expr_file, header = TRUE)
expr <- expr[expr$gene1 %in% tucr_ids, ]

# ── TUCR regions: looked up by TUCR ID from the GBM_WT matrix ───────────────
regions <- read.delim(region_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
coords  <- regions[regions$tucr_id %in% tucr_ids, ]

missing_region <- setdiff(tucr_ids, coords$tucr_id)
missing_expr   <- setdiff(tucr_ids, expr$gene1)
if (length(missing_region) > 0) warning("No region in GBM_WT file for: ", paste(missing_region, collapse = ", "))
if (length(missing_expr)   > 0) warning("Not in ", prefix, " matrix: ",    paste(missing_expr,   collapse = ", "))

cat("TUCR regions used:", nrow(coords), "\n")
TUCR regions used: 6 
print(coords)

# ── All sample columns → sample ID: "...TCGA.CS.4941.01A.01R..." → "TCGA-CS-4941-01A"
sample_cols <- sort(grep("TCGA", colnames(expr), value = TRUE))
sample_ids  <- gsub("\\.", "-", sub(".*(TCGA\\.[^.]+\\.[^.]+\\.[^.]+).*", "\\1", sample_cols))
cat("Samples in matrix:", length(sample_ids), "\n")
Samples in matrix: 382 
missing_ids   <- c()  # track samples with no CNV file
failed_writes <- c()  # track samples whose output file could not be written

for (j in seq_along(sample_ids)) {

  sample_name <- sample_ids[j]
  cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
  cat("Processing:", sample_name, "\n")

  # ── 1. Find CNV file for this sample ─────────────────────────────────────
  cnv_file <- file.path(cnv_dir, paste0(sample_name, ".txt"))

  if (!file.exists(cnv_file)) {
    warning(paste("No CNV file found for:", sample_name, "— skipping"))
    missing_ids <- c(missing_ids, sample_name)
    next
  }

  # ── 2. Load CNV file ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cnv <- fread(cnv_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
  colnames(cnv)[2] <- "Chromosome"
  colnames(cnv)[3] <- "Start"
  colnames(cnv)[4] <- "End"
  cnv$Chromosome <- trimws(cnv$Chromosome)
  cnv$Start      <- as.integer(cnv$Start)
  cnv$End        <- as.integer(cnv$End)

  # ── 3. Expression for this sample ────────────────────────────────────────
  third <- data.frame(
    tucr_id = as.character(trimws(expr$gene1)),
    score   = as.numeric(expr[[sample_cols[j]]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # ── 4. Find overlapping regions ───────────────────────────────────────────
  results <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(coords))) {

    chr           <- coords$tucr_region_chr[i]
    coord_start   <- coords$tucr_region_start[i]
    coord_end     <- coords$tucr_region_end[i]
    coord_tucr_id <- coords$tucr_id[i]
    tucr_region   <- coords$tucr_region[i]

    overlaps <- cnv[
      cnv$Chromosome == chr &
      (
        (cnv$Start <= coord_start & cnv$End >= coord_start) |
        (cnv$Start <= coord_end   & cnv$End >= coord_end)   |
        (cnv$Start >= coord_start & cnv$End <= coord_end)
      ),
    ]

    if (nrow(overlaps) == 0) next

    overlaps$tucr_region <- tucr_region
    overlaps$tucr_id     <- coord_tucr_id

    match_row <- third[third$tucr_id == coord_tucr_id, ]

    if (nrow(match_row) > 0) {
      overlaps$score <- match_row$score[1]
    } else {
      overlaps$score <- NA
      warning(paste("No expression for tucr_id:", coord_tucr_id))
    }

    results[[i]] <- overlaps
  }

  # ── 5. Combine all results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (length(results) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No overlaps found for:", sample_name))
    next
  }

  final <- rbindlist(results, fill = TRUE)
  final$sample_id <- sample_name
  final$case_id   <- substr(sample_name, 1, 12)
  final$cnv_type  <- cnv_map$cnv_type[match(sample_name, cnv_map$rna_sample)]
  cat("  Overlapping rows:", nrow(final), "\n")

  # ── 6. Write output (file name = sample ID, folder has the prefix) ─────────
  out_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(sample_name, ".txt"))
  if (file.exists(out_file)) unlink(out_file, force = TRUE)

  ok <- tryCatch({
    fwrite(final, out_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Could not write:", out_file, "—", conditionMessage(e)))
    FALSE
  })
  if (!ok) failed_writes <- c(failed_writes, sample_name)
}

# p-value that returns NA instead of an error when there are too few points
safe_p <- function(x, y, method) {
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = method)$p.value)
}

run_correlation <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(tucr_id, tucr_region) %>%
    summarise(
      n_samples   = n_distinct(sample_id),
      n_patients  = n_distinct(case_id),
      correlation = cor(Copy_Number, score),
      pearson_p   = safe_p(Copy_Number, score, "pearson"),
      spearman    = cor(Copy_Number, score, method = "spearman"),
      spearman_p  = safe_p(Copy_Number, score, "spearman"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

plot_tucrs <- function(df, suffix) {

  dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  failed_plots <- c()

  for (plot_id in tucr_ids) {

    df_region <- df %>% filter(tucr_id == plot_id)
    if (nrow(df_region) < 3) { cat("Skipping", plot_id, "- fewer than 3 samples\n"); next }

    print(df_region)
    corr_val    <- round(cor(df_region$score, df_region$Copy_Number), 5)
    tucr_region <- df_region$tucr_region[1]
    p <- ggplot(df_region, aes(x = score, y = Copy_Number)) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
        ggtitle(paste("Region:", tucr_region, "| Correlation = ", corr_val, " | TUCR-ID: ", plot_id)) +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(df$Copy_Number, na.rm = TRUE), by = 2)) +
        theme_bw()

    print(p)

    pdf_file <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", plot_id, "_cnv_correlation", suffix, ".pdf"))
    if (file.exists(pdf_file)) unlink(pdf_file, force = TRUE)

    ok <- tryCatch({
      ggsave(filename = pdf_file, plot = p, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) { warning(paste("Could not save:", pdf_file)); FALSE })
    if (!ok) failed_plots <- c(failed_plots, basename(pdf_file))
  }

  if (length(failed_plots) > 0) {
    cat("\n⚠ Plots not saved:\n"); print(failed_plots)
  } else {
    cat("\n✔ All plots saved to:", plot_dir, "\n")
  }
}

Correlation
